question: Who among the following was appointed as the Chairman of the Airports Authority of India (AAI), in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vipin Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vipin Kumar was appointed as the Chairman of the Airports Authority of India (AAI) in **October 2024**.
 
• The Airports Authority of India is a **statutory body under the Ministry of Civil Aviation**, responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.
 
• Vipin Kumar's appointment comes with the mandate to oversee critical modernization projects and ensure the growth and sustainability of India's aviation sector.
 
• He has extensive experience in aviation management and has previously held significant roles within the aviation sector.
 
• His leadership is expected to enhance India's airport infrastructure, focusing on passenger experience and operational efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Airports Authority of India (AAI):**

 
 
• Established in 1995, the AAI manages 137 airports in India, including 24 international airports, 10 customs airports, and 103 domestic airports.
 
• AAI is responsible for providing **Air Traffic Management (ATM)** services over Indian airspace and adjoining oceanic areas.
 
• It plays a key role in implementing government initiatives for enhancing regional connectivity, such as the **UDAN (Ude Desh ka Aam Naagrik) scheme**.
 
 
 
• **UDAN Scheme:**
 
 
• Launched in 2017 under the Regional Connectivity Scheme (RCS), UDAN aims to make air travel affordable and accessible to the common citizen.
 
• The scheme focuses on connecting underserved and unserved airports across India.
 
• Under UDAN, airlines receive financial incentives and concessions to operate on regional routes.
 
 
 
• **Modernization of Airports:**
 
 
• India is investing heavily in airport modernization to cater to the rising demand for air travel.
 
• Major airports such as Delhi and Mumbai are undergoing expansion, while greenfield projects like Navi Mumbai International Airport are in progress.
 
• Digital solutions like **DigiYatra** are being implemented to enhance passenger convenience through biometric-enabled seamless travel.
 
 
 
• **Global Aviation Trends:**
 
 
• India is the third-largest aviation market globally and is expected to become the largest by 2030.
 
• Sustainability initiatives, such as the use of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), are gaining momentum globally.
 
• Technological advancements like AI in air traffic management and smart airports are shaping the future of the aviation industry.
